mainText: Spurs beat Coventry to earn first league win of the season. Tottenham Hotspur record their first Premier League win of the season and move off the bottom of the table with a home victory over Coventry City. Ronaldo given 30-day suspension and £215 fine by Portuguese FA. Cristiano Ronaldo is given a 30-day suspension by the Portuguese Football Federation after leaving his country's international camp last month. Who has made Troy's Premier League team of the week?. After every round of Premier League matches this season, Troy Deeney gives us his team of the week. Do you agree with his choices?

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget. Influential Labour figures had been pushing for equalising CGT and income tax, but critics have said this could drive wealthy people out of Britain. How the attack on an Australian MP unfolded. BBC's Katy Watson is in Wangaratta visiting the scene of the incident and the church where the community has held a vigil for the independent MP. We asked teens what schools should teach them about work. This is what they said. Teenagers say they want more work experience at school and opportunities to improve their communication skills. Storm Austen to bring severe gales to UK as weather warning issued. The first named storm of the season - Austen - will bring damaging winds and heavy rain to parts of the UK on Friday.
